niche.habitat: Verrin's Ring Shear-Lanes (1.4–1.6 Rv), preferring density waves and resonance edges where orbital shear is highest.
niche.diet: Water ice, hydrogen peroxide frost, grazers, reaction-mass exhaust plumes.
niche.active: Continuous diurnal activity; hunting peaks during Kessler cascade events when debris density spikes.

body: Asymmetric body: central clathrate-brain core protected by 1 mm skin; magenta-hinged reflective sail on port side for radiation pressure; starboard cluster of sublimation nozzles; shifted-amber photoreceptor array for Doppler sensing; fine debris-tracking filaments extendable from flanks.

links: Phasing requires knowing prey's orbital period
Period shifts reflected light frequency via Doppler effect
Eyes evolved shifted-amber photoreceptors to read spectral shift

skill.effect: Locks onto prey's orbital period, predicting position for 5 turns. +50% hit chance on predicted intercept.

chains.weakness: Blind to optical phasing during eclipse; sensors rely on reflected light.
observe: Amber eyes glow with shifted spectrum when targeting
Tracking movements anticipate prey's future position
Lock beam points ahead of prey velocity vector

journal.en: It doesn't see where you are; it sees where you'll be.

links: Delta-v requires ejected mass for orbit changes
Mass must be recovered from environment
Catalyst bladders evolved to maximize exhaust velocity

skill.effect: Burns ice and peroxide, delivering 15 m/s delta-v. Can change semi-major axis for Hohmann transfers.

chains.weakness: High peroxide use risks internal poisoning; 10% chance of self-damage if burn exceeds capacity.
observe: Nozzle clusters vent white gas with visible heat haze
Body color deepens with peroxide load
Mass gauge drops visibly with each maneuver

journal.en: It eats poison to buy speed.

links: Thrust can be harvested for free altitude gain
Hinge allows sail to catch radiation without blocking nozzles
Hinged sail evolved to balance lift and thrust vectoring

skill.effect: Uses radiation pressure to gain 0.5 altitude without mass cost. Reduces energy cost of outbound transfers.

chains.weakness: Sail blocks retro-thrust; cannot burn inward while sail is active.
observe: Magenta sail catches starlight and shimmers
Sail hinge clicks when adjusting angle
Outward spiral path visible during idle drift

journal.en: The star pushes it up; gravity pays the debt.

links: Kessler cascade creates chaotic debris field
Debris forces prey to expend reaction mass to survive
Reaction mass exhaust plumes reveal prey position
Filaments evolved to detect and track exhaust plumes

skill.effect: In debris fields, detects panic burns of prey. +75% capture chance; reveals hidden grazers.

chains.weakness: Filaments can snag on large debris fragments; movement restricted in dense debris.
observe: Filaments extend into debris cloud like sensory hairs
Predator ignores open ice to focus on debris lanes

journal.en: In the storm of broken ice, the predator watches the sparks.

relations.note: (council kind 'Predator-Prey') Specialist hunter of grazers; uses Kessler cascades to flush prey and force mass expenditure, leaving them vulnerable to phasing strikes.

temperament: Calculating patience broken by explosive action during debris events.
secrets: Can trigger micro-cascades by venting superheated gas onto slow-moving ice chunks to create cover and flush prey.
Sail pigment is magenta bacteriorhodopsin, allowing limited photosynthesis during the sail's outward drift.
moments: The ring goes dark as a cascade erupts; ice shards scream past. The Cerradora folds its sail, vents a controlled plume of white gas, and dives into the chaos where the grazers' panicked thrusts betray them. It emerges only when the debris clears, heavy with the bloated form of a grazer caught in the shear.

journal.en: It lives in the gaps between orbits.
A shadow that moves by breaking physics.
The Kessler storm is its hunting ground.
It waits for the universe to break so it can strike.
